Dept of Surgery 'Resident/fellow listing' PDF (surgery.uchicago.edu/pdf/ResFellowList.pdf, Wayback 2014-12-01), Neurosurgery section, 11 residents: Vasenina 1, Mar 2, Polster 2, Hobbs 3, Ralston 4, Stamates 4, Bhansali 5, Khader Eliyas 5, Shakur 6, Dey 7, Mansour 7. Operative Word Fall 2014 confirms Vasenina as the only 2014 neurosurgery intern and Wong as a 2014 graduate.
gap_details.2017-2018: Seen only through Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2018-22 (2018-05-23). The CC captures of 2017-09, 2017-11 and 2018-01 still showed the 2016-17 list, and Wayback has no capture of this page after 2016-11.
gap_details.2018-2019: Still unobserved after phase 2: Wayback gapaudit of surgery/surgery-sites/gme hosts, linkaudit of the residency/alumni pages, and Common Crawl over the whole surgery.uchicago.edu host for every 2018-2019 crawl (2019-13 retried OK) found no residents page after 2018-05 (the residency page 2018-08..2019-06 carries no names; the 'Resident & Fellow Listing' link still pointed to the 2016 PDF). Bracketed 6 reconstructed. Hobbs (PGY-7) inferred graduate (NPI neurosurgery practice IN). Batbold NPI enumerated 2018-06 (IL) -> 2018 intern. Heather Smith left for UChicago pathology (2018 or 2019); Ahmadpour joined at PGY-2 (2018) or PGY-3 (2019).
gap_details.2020-2021: The only capture is 2021-05-18 (spring). PGYs have advanced and the 2020 interns are listed, so it is used as 2020-21.
gap_details.2021-2022: Still no roster capture (CC incl. retried 2022-05/2022-21 and whole neurosurgery host; Wayback). Program history page neurosurgery.uchicago.edu/history-women (J. Hekmat-panah, Feb 2022): 'Of our eleven neurosurgical residents in the 2021-2022 academic year, five were women'. Known/bracketed list = Choi 7, Platt 7, Castro 6, Satzer 6, Ahmadpour 5, Batbold 4, Biro 3, Mendoza-Elias 3, Alkhalid 2, Nguyen 2, Sweid 1 (NPI 2021-04 IL) = 11, 4 women; Zhe Wang (F) has a UChicago-address NPI from 2021-04, and Castro was on a Northwestern research fellowship 2020-22, which would explain 5 women among 11. Castro and Satzer added as reconstructed (program-confirmed 2023 graduates). Mansi was at Nebraska.
gap_details.2022-2023: Still no roster capture. Castro and Satzer (PGY-7) confirmed 2023 graduates by program pages and added as reconstructed; Reddy NPI 2022-05 (IL) -> 2022 intern; Mansi at Nebraska (PGY-3) and joined UChicago at PGY-4 in 2023-24. Nguyen gone by 2023-24 (UChicago radiology, PubMed 2025).
gap_details.2023-2024: The only capture is 2024-05-24, from when the page was created. It is headed '2023- 2024' and agrees with 2024-25.
gap_details.2025-2026: Uses the 2026-01-20 capture. The 2025-07-11 capture, also headed 2025-2026, still lists Nasya Mendoza-Elias at PGY-6, so it is loaded as a one-row 'other' capture.
gap_details.2026-2027: Live page (2026-09-27, rechecked 2026-09-28) headed '2026- 2027'. Independently confirmed by the department's June 2026 newsletter: graduate Biro; new interns Kazi, McAfee, Sconzo; joiners Farooq (PGY3) and Khalili (PGY2); chiefs Alkhalid and Mansi (PGY7). Pons Torres and Griggs absent from the live list; the newsletter does not mention them.

adjudication_summary.note: After phase 2 (2026-09-28). The 8 gap-artefact 'LEFT' calls are resolved (Dey, Mansour: PGY-7 on the Dec 2014 listing; Wong: 2014 graduate; Hobbs, Choi, Platt: inferred completions; Castro, Satzer: program-confirmed 2023 graduates). SWITCHED: Mar (NPI-based, adjudicator), Smith (pathology, PubMed), Nguyen (radiology, PubMed). 'did not complete': Mendoza-Elias, Griggs. 'outcome unknown': Khader-Eliyas. The 'TRANSFERRED (University of Missouri-Columbia)' call for Pons Torres is a false surname match (Jose Torres, program 89); her outcome is unknown.

problems: Common Crawl cluster.idx range requests failed for CC-MAIN-2018-09 (prefix surgery.uchicago.edu/education/residency/neurosurgery; 2017-18 is observed anyway) and CC-MAIN-2022-05 (prefix surgery.uchicago.edu/education/neurosurgery-residency; that page was already 404). The broad cclocal scan (surgery)/education + neurosurgery)/) was stopped after CC-MAIN-2017-47 and replaced with narrow-prefix scans (p78/ccone.py, ccloop.sh) over 2017-43..2019-30 and 2021-31..2024-10. The CC-MAIN-2017-39 WARC fetch that failed was retried and succeeded (stale 2016-17 list). The recent departures (Pons Torres, Griggs) and joiners (Farooq, Khalili) rest on the single live capture. Recheck them on a later capture. There is no neurosurgery alumni page, and only the 2018 Dept of Surgery graduates page exists (Ralston and Stamates inserted into training_history). PHASE 2: all previously failed CC crawls retried successfully (2018-09, 2022-05, 2019-13, 2022-21, 2024-51). PubMed E-utilities returned HTTP 429 intermittently (shared IP); retried with backoff. Later Operative Word issues (July/Oct 2015, 2016) and the 2017 annual report (issuu) are not archived. Adjudicator uses training_history start_year as entry year, so the transfer-in rows move Mansi/Farooq/Khalili/Ahmadpour to their arrival year in its table.
